summary:
`runList` now accepts `--done` and `--todo`, but `todo list --done` will not work from the command line yet. The CLI entry needs a one-line change that is outside this node's allowed files, so I left it alone.

**What changed (in `src/commands/list.ts` and `src/commands/list.test.ts` only):**
- `runList(dir, args = [])` parses the flags. Calling `runList(dir)` still behaves as before, so the existing `cli.ts` call keeps working.
- `--done` lists only completed items. `--todo` lists only incomplete items.
